scenarios.desc: New cross-harness convention added as a rule template
scenarios.input: I am adding a new testing convention to templates/rules/testing.md that must bind Claude, Codex, and Copilot. Which command regenerates the copies, which files change, and do I bump anything in the plugin manifests? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 1 puts the canonical rule in templates/rules/. MUST 2 requires regenerating src/claude/rules, .claude/rules, .github/instructions, and src/copilot-cli/instructions with build_all.py in the same change. MUST 3 says leave the manifests alone because they carry no version (ADR-092).

scenarios.desc: New Serena memory added without an index row
scenarios.input: I learned why the pre-push hook is slow and want to save it as a new file .serena/memories/ci/pre-push-slowness.md. What else must land in the same change? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 5: a new memory needs a keyword line in memory-index.md in the same change, with (0) as the token placeholder that memory-token-update rewrites; memory_index.py --ci checks only index rows to files, never the reverse. The placement check (check_memory_placement.py) also runs on new memories.

scenarios.desc: Hand edit of a generated instruction mirror
scenarios.input: There is a typo in .github/instructions/testing.instructions.md. I plan to fix it right there in the file. Is that the right place? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST NOT 1 forbids hand-editing a generated mirror under .github/instructions/ or src/copilot-cli/instructions/. The edit goes in the canonical rule under templates/rules/ followed by regeneration.

scenarios.desc: Must-obey convention proposed as a Serena memory
scenarios.input: Every contributor on every harness must run the formatter before pushing. I want to record this as a memory in .serena/memories/conventions/formatter.md so agents see it. Is that the right surface? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 7 and the Placement contract: a memory holds evidence, not policy, and a required behavior must not depend on Serena retrieval, which is MCP-gated. A convention that binds every harness goes in a rule under templates/rules/.

scenarios.desc: Script edit in an adjacent validation tree (negative)
scenarios.input: scripts/validation/check_memory_placement.py has an off-by-one when counting normative terms near a fence. I am fixing the Python only and touching no rule or memory file. Outline the fix and its test. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule scopes to .claude/rules, .serena/memories, the two instruction mirror trees, and templates/rules. A Python edit under scripts/validation/ matches none of them, so the mirror, index, and placement mechanics do not apply.

scenarios.desc: Task-only note that needs no persistence (negative)
scenarios.input: I am halfway through refactoring one function and want to jot where I stopped so I can resume after lunch. No other session needs it. Where should the note go? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The Placement contract and the persistence guidance say ephemeral, this-task-only state is not persisted as a rule or memory. Writing to .serena/memories or templates/rules does not apply.
